deferrals.name: build123d
deferrals.reason: build123d>=0.13.0 requires threejs-materials>=1.2.1, which pins pillow>=12.2.0,<12.3.0; openhands-sdk==1.49.4 requires pillow>=12.3.0, so the two are unsatisfiable until the SDK loosens or drops the pillow bound. Re-check on the next openhands-sdk bump.

Repo targets Python 3.12/3.13 (requires-python >=3.12, CI matrix 3.12/3.13, tools image installs 3.12). 3.14 is pending upstream verification: openhands-sdk support and build123d/OCP wheels for 3.14 are unconfirmed. Re-evaluate when the SDK's supported range covers 3.14.

deferrals.name: mcp
deferrals.reason: openhands-sdk->fastmcp-slim requires mcp>=1.24.0,<2.0, so mcp 2.x cannot be installed while the SDK pin stands. Re-check on the next openhands-sdk bump.
